subject.title: [Feature]: Add description and enum to message tool's channel parameter

question: Should the description-only fix in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/84589 fully resolve this issue, or must the schema also expose a dynamic channel enum?
rationale: The description directly addresses the demonstrated confusion, while enum support changes schema construction and must preserve dynamic plugin identifiers and lightweight agent-tool discovery.

options.title: Land description only
options.body: Refresh and land the existing description-and-test change, closing this issue unless a separate concrete enum-related failure remains.

options.title: Require dynamic enum
options.body: Keep this issue open after the description fix and design the enum from lightweight registered-channel metadata without hard-coded provider names.

recommendation.title: Land description only
recommendation.body: Refresh and land the existing description-and-test change, closing this issue unless a separate concrete enum-related failure remains.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current schema/routing refactor history and previously articulated the description-first, dynamic-enum-only boundary for this issue.
